title: Restoration of Jacob and Fall of Babylon

questions.question: For the LORD will have compassion on Jacob and will again choose whom?
How you are fallen from heaven, O Day Star, son of the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 14:12 (ESV): "O Day Star, son of Dawn!"

questions.question: You said in your heart, "I will ascend to heaven; above the stars of God I will set my what on high?"
questions.explanation: Isaiah 14:13 (ESV): "I will set my throne on high;"

questions.question: But you are brought down to Sheol, to the far reaches of the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 14:15 (ESV): "to the far reaches of the pit."

questions.question: The LORD of hosts has sworn: "As I have planned, so shall it be, and as I have purposed, so shall it what?"
And the sojourner will join them and attach himself to the house of whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 14:1 (ESV): "attach himself to the house of Jacob."

questions.question: When the LORD has given you rest from your pain and turmoil and the hard service with which you were made to serve, you will take up this taunt against whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 14:4 (ESV): "you will take up this taunt against the king of Babylon:"

questions.question: The LORD has broken the staff of the wicked, the scepter of what?
The whole earth is at rest and quiet; they break forth into what?
Sheol beneath is stirred up to meet you when you come; it rouses the shades to greet you, all who were what of the earth?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 14:9 (ESV): "all who were leaders of the earth;"

questions.question: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will make myself like the whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 14:14 (ESV): "I will make myself like the Most High."

questions.question: Is this the man who made the earth tremble, who shook what?
But you are cast out, away from your grave, like a loathed what?
I will break the Assyrian in my land, and on my mountains trample him underfoot; and his yoke shall depart from whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 14:25 (ESV): "and his yoke shall depart from them,"

questions.question: Do not rejoice, O Philistia, all of you, that the rod that struck you is broken, for from the serpent's root will come forth an adder, and its fruit will be a what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 14:29 (ESV): "and its fruit will be a flying fiery serpent."

key_verse_text: How you are fallen from heaven, O Day Star, son of Dawn! How you are cut down to the ground, you who laid the nations low!
